questions.text: Pizza is most famously associated with which country?
questions.explanation: Modern pizza developed in Naples, Italy.

questions.text: Which sweet food do bees make from flower nectar?
questions.explanation: Bees turn nectar into honey and store it in the hive.

questions.text: Which spirit is the base of a classic mojito?
questions.explanation: A mojito combines white rum, mint, lime, sugar and soda.

questions.text: What is guacamole mainly made from?
Which country is the home of paella?
Which grain is the main ingredient of Scotch malt whisky?
questions.explanation: Single malt Scotch is made from malted barley.

questions.text: Kimchi is a staple of the cuisine of which country?
questions.explanation: Kimchi is fermented vegetables, central to Korean food.

questions.text: Which Italian dessert's name means pick me up?
questions.explanation: Tiramisu translates roughly as pick me up.

questions.text: Which French dessert is custard topped with hard caramelised sugar?
questions.explanation: Creme brulee has a brittle caramel crust.

questions.text: Which Indian bread is leavened and traditionally baked on the wall of a clay tandoor oven?
questions.explanation: Naan is baked on the walls of a tandoor.

questions.text: Which French town gives its name to a famous brandy?
questions.explanation: Cognac brandy is made in and around the town of Cognac.

questions.text: Which cocktail mixes gin, Campari and sweet vermouth?
questions.explanation: A Negroni uses equal parts gin, Campari and sweet vermouth.

questions.text: The dessert pavlova is named after a dancer from which country?
questions.explanation: It honours the Russian ballerina Anna Pavlova.

questions.text: Which underground fungus, hunted with trained dogs or pigs, is prized in French and Italian cooking?
questions.explanation: Truffles grow underground near tree roots and are found by scent.

questions.text: Which Scandinavian spirit, flavoured with caraway or dill, is often called water of life?
questions.explanation: Aquavit means water of life and is flavoured with herbs and spices.

spares.text: Which Mexican sauce is made with chocolate and chilli?
spares.explanation: Mole poblano blends chilli and chocolate.

spares.text: Which soup is typically made with beetroot?
spares.explanation: Borscht gets its red colour from beetroot.

spares.text: Which red grape is a main variety used in Champagne?
spares.explanation: Champagne uses Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.
